name: Agave ERC-677 reentrancy during aToken burn
summary: Agave's Aave v2 fork liquidation sends the seized collateral to the liquidator before the borrower's accounting is final, with no reentrancy guard. Gnosis bridged WETH is ERC-677 and calls onTokenTransfer on the recipient, so the attacker liquidated its own position and re-entered borrow() from the callback, draining six markets against collateral already seized.
notes: liquidationCall runs in the LendingPoolCollateralManager the AddressesProvider pointed to at launch, after the WETH listing and collateral setup; that route sets the age. LINK's later borrow enablement only shaped the attacker's dust position; the genesis markets already allowed it.

Loss is the aToken reserves' depletion in the exploit transaction, including WETH paid on to the flash-swap pairs; the setup transaction moved only dust. XDAI is WXDAI unwrapped by its aToken reserve.
Separate incident from Hundred Finance on Gnosis the same day: a Compound fork with its own borrow-before-accounting code.
